name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at the last hour's tight range with order flow
why: Stops cluster just beyond the last hour's tight range; aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md).
